transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I keep losing interest in the projects and activities I usually care about, even when everything in my life is going fine. It's been causing some real strain with my girlfriend, and when we tried to set up couples counseling, the intake clinician recommended I get an individual psychiatric evaluation first.
How long have you been experiencing this loss of interest in activities that you normally enjoy?

This current low spell, where I've lost interest in my projects and feel so dragged down, has been hanging around in some form for most of the past year. Looking back, I can see that these cycles of getting really revved up for a few days and then sinking into these long low stretches have been happening off and on for about a year now.
Can you describe these periods when you get 'really revved up' - what happens during those times, and how do they differ from your normal mood and the low spells you've been experiencing?

During those times, I feel completely amped up, buzzing with energy, and so confident that I feel like I could run my own design firm. My mind races with ideas, keeping me awake at night, and I'll impulsively buy gear on my credit card or sign up for way too many projects at once. It's the total opposite of my low spells, where I feel completely sluggish, foggy, and lose interest in everything.

Can you estimate how often these 'revved up' periods and low spells occur, and do they seem to follow a pattern or cycle, such as happening at specific times of the year or in response to particular events?

These cycles have been happening off and on for about a year, with the revved-up phases lasting just a few days and the low spells dragging on for most of the year. There isn't really a seasonal pattern to it, but the shifts became much more noticeable after I moved in with my girlfriend and took on more design leadership roles at work.

Do you experience any other symptoms during these 'revved up' periods, such as increased talkativeness, distractibility, or involvement in activities that have a high potential for painful consequences, like excessive spending or risky behaviors?

Yes, during those wired times I've definitely made some impulsive purchases. I've put expensive camping gear, art supplies, and even a deposit for a last-minute trip on my credit card without checking my budget first. It's only later on that I start stressing about how I'm going to pay it all off.
Can you tell me more about how quickly you shift from these 'revved up' periods to the low spells, and do you ever experience both extremes at the same time or very close together?

The revved-up phases usually last for just a few days, and then I'll sink into the longer low spells that can hang around for weeks or months. I don't experience both of those extremes at the same time; they are separate, alternating parts of a cycle that's been happening off and on for about a year.
During these 'revved up' periods, do you feel that your mood is irritable or if you're more likely to be exceptionally happy or euphoric?

It's actually a mix of both. I'll feel unusually amped up and upbeat, like every single thing is a great idea, but at the same time, I get easily irritated and set off by small things, like my girlfriend questioning my new projects.
Can you clarify if there are any periods of normal mood in between these 'revved up' and low spells, or do you tend to shift directly from one extreme to the other?
I'm not completely sure, to be honest. I haven't paid close enough attention to notice if there are truly "normal" periods in between, or if I just slide directly from one phase right into the other.

Do you ever feel like you're back to your normal self, with a stable mood, between these episodes of feeling 'revved up' and the low spells, or is it more like you're constantly shifting between these two extremes?

I'm not entirely sure, because over the last year it feels like I've been constantly shifting or just stuck in that low spell. I don't really recall having many periods where I felt truly "normal" or stable in between.
Can you think of any specific times in the past year when you felt completely stable and normal, without either the 'revved up' or low spell symptoms, even if it was just for a short period?

Honestly, it's really hard to recall any specific times over the past year where I felt completely stable or normal. The low spells have been hanging around in some form for most of the year, and otherwise I've just been cycling back and forth between those low periods and the short, revved-up phases.
Can you think of any instance in the past year where you had at least two months of relatively stable mood without significant episodes of being 'revved up' or in a low spell?

No, I definitely haven't had a solid two-month stretch of feeling stable this past year. The low, dragging feelings have been there in some form for most of the year, and whenever I wasn't feeling down, I was usually in one of those revved-up phases. There really hasn't been any room for a normal, stable baseline.

Have you experienced any distinct periods of at least two months where your mood was consistently stable and free from both the 'revved up' and low spell symptoms, or has it been a constant fluctuation between these two states over the past year?

I'm not quite sure, and I haven't tracked things closely enough to know if I've had a full two-month stretch of feeling completely stable. It really just feels like I've been riding this rollercoaster of ups and downs, or dealing with those low feelings pretty consistently, over the past year.
Can you confirm if there has been any period, no matter how brief, within the past year where you felt completely free of both the 'revved up' and low spell symptoms for at least a few weeks?

No, I haven't really had a clear period of even a few weeks where I felt completely normal. The low feelings have been hanging around in some form for most of the past year, and these cycles of getting revved up and then sinking back down have just been happening off and on the whole time.

Can you confirm whether you have experienced any period, regardless of length, within the past year where your mood was consistently stable, without any episodes of being 'revved up' or in a low spell, or has it been a constant fluctuation between these states?

It has felt like a pretty constant cycle without much stable ground over the past year. The low spell has been hanging around in some form for most of the year, only occasionally interrupted by those brief, highly-energized "revved up" phases. It's just been a continuous loop of those two states.
Have you ever had a period of at least two months in your life, not just the past year, where you felt consistently stable and free from both the 'revved up' and low spell symptoms?

I'm not quite sure, to be honest. It's really hard to recall a solid two-month block in my life where I felt completely stable and free of both the highs and the lows. Since these cycles have been happening off and on for a long time now, I can't really point to a time like that.

Can you think of any time in your entire life, before the past year, when you had a period of at least two months where your mood was consistently stable, without significant episodes of being 'revved up' or in a low spell?

I'm not really sure and can't quite recall if I've ever had a solid two-month period of complete stability. I mostly just remember these cycles of ups and downs happening off and on for a long time, and they've even strained my past relationships.
Can you estimate the total duration of all the periods where you felt 'revved up' over the past year, and compare that to the total duration of the low spells?

The "revved up" periods are actually pretty short, usually only lasting for a few days at a time when they happen. In contrast, the low spells are much longer, with this current low period dragging on in some form for most of the past year.
Have you ever experienced a distinct period of hypomanic symptoms, such as increased energy and reduced need for sleep, that lasted for at least four consecutive days?

Yes, I definitely have those periods where I feel extremely amped up and buzzing with energy. During those times, my mind races and I'll wake up before my alarm feeling fully energized without needing much sleep. These high-energy phases usually last for a few days at a time, sometimes right around four days, and they've been happening off and on for about a year.

Can you confirm whether these 'revved up' periods, which you described as lasting a few days, have ever met or exceeded a duration of at least four consecutive days, and if so, how frequently this has occurred over the past year?

Yes, I can confirm that those revved-up periods usually last right around four days at a time. They have been happening off and on over the course of the past year, though I don't have an exact count of how many times it's happened.

Have you experienced any other symptoms during these 'revved up' periods, such as increased talkativeness, distractibility, or involvement in activities that have a high potential for painful consequences, and if so, can you describe them in more detail?

Yes, I've definitely made some impulsive choices during those wired times that I end up worrying about later. I've put expensive camping gear and art supplies on my credit card, and even put down a deposit on a last-minute trip without checking my budget first. Once I come back down, I get really stressed trying to figure out how I'm going to pay it all off.

I'm not entirely sure, to be honest. Over the past year, it has just felt like a continuous cycle of ups and downs without a solid two-month break. Before this past year, I can't really recall clearly how long any of my stable periods might have lasted.
Can you recall any specific year in your life before the past year where you did not experience these cycles of 'revved up' and low spells, and instead felt consistently stable for the entire year?

I'm not really sure, and I can't recall a specific year where I felt completely stable. It feels like these patterns have been happening for a while now, so it's hard to pinpoint any time in my past when things were perfectly steady.

Can you recall any period in your life, regardless of length, where you felt your mood was consistently stable, without significant episodes of being 'revved up' or in a low spell, and if so, how did that period differ from your current experiences?

I can't really recall a clear, prolonged period of perfect stability recently, as these ups and downs have been happening for at least a year now. It feels like I've just been constantly cycling between the highs and lows without any real, steady break in between.

I'm not really sure, and I haven't really thought about it that way. These ups and downs feel like they've been a pattern in my life for a long time, making it hard to recall a completely stable year.
